business_summary: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Limited provide quality and affordable healthcare solutions worldwide. It offers products in various therapeutic areas, such gynaecology, cardiovascular, blood-related, pain and analgesics, oncology/anti-neoplastics, anti-infectives, vitamins, minerals and nutrients, respiratory, HIV antivirals, Metabolics, gastro, anti-diabetic, neuro, derma, and mRNA vaccine. It provides its products under Orofer-Xt, Zostum, Bevon, Amaryl M, Orofer Fcm, Maxtra, Clexane, Metpure-Xl, Amaryl, Spegra, Feronia-Xt, Cardace, Pause, Lornit, Targocid, Orofer-S, Lasilactone, Gros, Orofer-Xt Liq, And Tenectase brand names. Emcure Pharmaceuticals Limited has a strategic partnership with Novo Nordisk India Pvt Ltd. for the development and commercialization of Poviztra, a semaglutide injection for weight loss. Emcure Pharmaceuticals Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Pune, India.
